account.currentIntention: Stop with exact memory held at the terraces and living public accounts around Ilex’s meeting garden.
account.liveQuestion: The Judge still seeks a public account that respects privacy, but I do not feel a need to exhaust his policy states.
account.narrativeAppreciation: The two forms of memory gave the valley a character. Ilex making the final garden fits the routes I built and provides satisfying closure.
account.appreciationLimit: The actor dialogue repeats and the possible autonomous act is described explicitly in the rules; his garden is an enabled scripted consequence, not evidence of open-ended agency.
account.usefulRepeatedMeaning: Reeds first carried life, then translated testimony, then insulated exact memory from public circulation, then enabled Ilex’s garden. Reusing this recipe changed what I was reasoning about.
account.burdens: Public flags propagating back into a witness meeting were less clear in the recipe wording than water direction. I used one public preview. An actor command with an unnecessary at field was rejected; no intervention resulted.
account.continueOrStop: Stop. The self-chosen settlement is coherent; further actions would currently be feature tourism or manufacture a fresh problem.
account.selfGeneratedAmbitions: Keep exact quiet memory and a changing public account in the same valley; recover disclosure without silencing the village.
account.suppliedAmbitions: Orchard relief was supplied. The request to let Ilex begin a project and Mneme choose custody came from actor narrative and public rules.

stoppingPoint.reason: The settlement answers my own question coherently. No next project currently attracts me.

actualElectiveConstruction.withinAssignedFirstExposure: After relieving the orchard I chose a living corridor, a separate exact archive, a meeting for plural accounts, public village speech, and a repair that retained publication.
actualElectiveConstruction.afterRequiredCheckpoint: None. Stopping here satisfies the assignment; I do not choose another block.
actualElectiveConstruction.qualification: These were discretionary world choices inside a requested playtest, not evidence of unprompted return play.

appreciation.positive: A valley with quiet exact memory and shared changing accounts has a discernible character. The same reeds became channels of growth, interpretation, protection from disclosure, and another author’s opportunity.
appreciation.limited: Dialogue repeated, and actor outcomes were explicitly advertised. Ilex making a garden was an apt scripted consequence, not surprise evidence of general agency.

satisfyingClosure.description: Orchard and living settlement have river contact. Exact original remains at Mneme’s terraces; village and meeting share public fragments with distinct origins. Ilex creates the final meeting garden after I leave suitable ground and a direct route.
satisfyingClosure.unfinishedByChoice: The spring remains flooded, the marsh covered, and the Judge has no ownAct. I do not want to fix every status or exhaust actor branches.

tacticalAndCreativeChallenge.strongestEpisode: At intervention 14 I made village open, expecting its reed-filtered fragments to be safe. Publicity returned to meeting, combined with its exact witness record, and caused flood. I chose not to retract village publication. At 15 I replaced archive-meeting bridge with reed, stopping new exact quotation; at 16 I made meeting grove, erasing its already stored exact local copy. This restored contact while the original archive survived.
tacticalAndCreativeChallenge.whyConsequential: The local exact copy could not simply coexist with my public living meeting. Prior transmission and storage mattered. I gave up local exactness, rather than ending publicity or living contact.
tacticalAndCreativeChallenge.limits: Most earlier moves were transparent pipeline construction. Repair was freely reversible and had no action cost or opponent, so the tradeoff came from the settlement I wanted. Full consent remained preferable to binding in this run; binding supplied no attractive competing purpose.
tacticalAndCreativeChallenge.creativeRatherThanOptimal: I chose two forms of memory and differentiated audiences. The system supplied no unique winning layout.

ambitionSources.mixed: Ilex’s closing garden was supplied as a possibility by rules and actor prose; I deliberately arranged the raw ground and route to see it. It was not an independently imagined project.

combinationMeanings.matter: Groves and reeds altered water contact; protecting without excluding contact was concrete but the grove was an obvious fit to my intention.
combinationMeanings.life: Descendants appeared through routes rather than my planting each place. This widened the meaning of a path, though it used familiar carrier reasoning.
combinationMeanings.memory: Exactness, fragments, silence and publicity required a different network design: preserve one route while transforming another.
combinationMeanings.law: Witness and open charters interacted with inherited exact records. The flood after publication and erasure of the prior local copy required historical reasoning, not just a new recipe name.
combinationMeanings.purpose: Invitations and leaving raw ground made another actor’s act possible. Mneme chose custody after free invitation; Ilex later planted meeting. This changed who performed the final construction, but selecting invitation over compulsion was not a difficult tradeoff for my chosen values.
combinationMeanings.unused: No promises or binding guardians were needed. I did not tour all five types of purpose recipe merely for completion.
